jobs.scene: Bare-handed binding of two modest feather vanes to the one existing practice arrow, with both hand pockets set aside.
jobs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Humanity Handbook wide horizontal narrative illustration, fine brown ink and restrained luminous natural watercolour on warm paper with softly dissolved margins. Reference 1 supplies the original traveller FACE, IDENTITY and STYLE only, NOT its old shelter, season or clothing. Reference 2 supplies the ENTIRE present OUTFIT. Same lean modern man about thirty with dark ear-length wavy hair, short beard. Preserve full grey-brown fur cap crown over TOP of head, tan ear/nape sides; pale tan overlapping above-knee body wrap over BOTH shoulders with chest tie and waist keeper; darker grey-brown separate sleeves to wrists and side-overlapped leg panels covering knees/calves to ankles; BOTH low pale closed skin foot covers over visible exterior woven bast soles, no bare toes or tall boots. The two small smooth pale tan thumb-less hand pockets have hair INSIDE and are REMOVED for this fine task; BOTH rest together on one clean bark sheet nearby. Hands BARE, all other clothes stay ON. Both low foot layers visible. Sparse BARE winter brush, cold December light, no lush autumn canopy. No other person, new cloak, animal-head hat, modern tool, hut or lean-to. At the clean craft stone beneath a NATURAL LIMESTONE ROCK LIP, seated low. He winds a fine tan plant thread around the rear of ONE slender pale wooden practice arrow across his lap. Exactly TWO modest matching brown-grey feather vanes lie lengthways on opposing sides near its rear, one partly hidden by perspective, NOT a feather fan. Rear notch beyond the vanes and a rounded integral wooden nose at the front. No separate point, bow, shooting, quiver or spare arrow. The subject is quiet delicate binding work. Background simple rock only; no branch-built roof or building.
input_roles: original approved identity/style independently, no setting or old clothing copied
